map.title: EXPLORE LEONIDA
map.subtitle: The community map of the GTA VI universe
map.soon: The detailed interactive map is coming soon.
map.note: Illustrative community atlas, not to scale. The six destination names come from official material; Rockstar has not published their exact positions.

regionDescriptions.viceCity: A major coastal metropolis inspired by Miami, with beaches, dense districts, high-rises and nightlife.
regionDescriptions.keys: A tropical chain of low-lying islands, bridges, marinas and waterways.
regionDescriptions.grassrivers: Vast wetlands, marshes, mangroves and shallow rivers.
regionDescriptions.portGellhorn: A smaller coastal town with motels, commercial roads and waterfront industry.
regionDescriptions.ambrosia: An inland rural and industrial area crossed by roads and work sites.
regionDescriptions.mountKalaga: A wooded mountain national park with rugged terrain and rocky waterways.
